items.criterion: The demo overview answers 126219 minor units a month, 1514633 a year and 4150 a day.
items.judgment: Read the demo overview and compare all three figures to the pinned values.

items.criterion: The seven demo category rows sum to the displayed monthly total and to the displayed annual total.
items.judgment: Sum the category rows and compare each sum to the headline figure beside them.

items.criterion: A charge anchored on the thirty-first falls on the twenty-eighth in a common February and returns to the thirty-first in March.
items.judgment: Read the charge window for the seeded month-end subscription and compare the dates.

items.criterion: A second reminder pass for one moment writes no further timeline entry.
items.judgment: Count the reminder entries before and after a replayed pass.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous reminder passes leave exactly one entry for each occurrence.
items.judgment: Fire two passes together and read the occurrence keys back from the store.

items.criterion: A seventh subscription on the free account is refused by the store with the cap named.
items.judgment: Post a seventh subscription and read the status and the message.

items.criterion: An anonymous request for an application route is denied by the server.
items.judgment: Request each application route with no token and read the status.

items.criterion: The four pinned listing lines parse to their exact minor units, currencies and dates.
items.judgment: Post the four lines to the parser and compare every field.

items.criterion: A month before the seeded increase computes at the earlier price.
items.judgment: Read the charge window either side of the effective date and compare the prices.

items.criterion: No scan row holds the bytes of an uploaded image.
items.judgment: Read the scan rows and check every column for raw bytes.

items.criterion: The export header reads exactly the fifteen pinned column names in order.
items.judgment: Read the first line of the export and compare it to the pinned header.

items.criterion: The overview upcoming timeline runs nearest first with a countdown in whole days on every row.
items.judgment: Read the upcoming rows and check the ordering and the countdown field.

items.criterion: The landing page carries the pinned hero opening, the pinned pricing headline and the pinned copyright line.
items.judgment: Fetch the landing page and search for each pinned string.

items.criterion: A list page above the cap of one hundred is refused with the cap named.
items.judgment: Request a page of five hundred and read the status and the message.

items.criterion: An erased account returns to the first-run state with a zero total.
items.judgment: Erase a fresh account and read the overview back.

items.criterion: Each public route carries a title and a description shared with no other route.
items.judgment: Fetch every public route and compare the title and description strings.

items.criterion: The design of the product reads as one hand across the marketing site and the tracker.
items.judgment: A person reads both halves and judges whether the ground, the ink, the signal colour and the type read as one system.
